title: ZeroStream Audio
summary: Stream via AirPlay, DLNA or Bluetooth to a USB audio interface or AUX out
description:
Turns your CardputerZero into a wireless audio receiver for your music.

Sources
- AirPlay: iPhone, iPad, Mac, iTunes / Apple Music on Windows
- DLNA / UPnP: Windows "Cast to Device", Android apps such as BubbleUPnP, foobar2000, MusicBee
- Bluetooth: pair any phone or PC (press K in the app to become visible for 3 minutes)
- Spotify Connect: used automatically when librespot is installed

Outputs
- any class-compliant USB audio interface (Focusrite Scarlett / Clarett / Vocaster and others); plug it in and running streams move over instantly
- the 3.5 mm AUX jack or the built-in speaker of the CardputerZero
- Bluetooth speakers that are connected to the CardputerZero

The app shows source, title and artist, sample rate and volume, controls play/pause and next/previous track, has a left/right test tone and keeps playing in the background after you leave it. English and German UI. Command line control over SSH: zerostream-audio status.
